book_title: 小蓝本高中卷4 均值不等式与柯西不等式
title: 幂平均不等式
stem_md:
设 $a_1, a_2, \cdots, a_n$ 为正实数, $\alpha > \beta > 0$, 则
$\left(\frac{a_1^\beta + a_2^\beta + \cdots + a_n^\beta}{n}\right)^{\frac{1}{\beta}} \leq \left(\frac{a_1^\alpha + a_2^\alpha + \cdots + a_n^\alpha}{n}\right)^{\frac{1}{\alpha}}$,
$a_1^{\alpha_1} a_2^{\alpha_2} \cdots a_n^{\alpha_n} \leq \alpha_1 a_1 + \alpha_2 a_2 + \cdots + \alpha_n a_n$.
original_text_md:
幂平均不等式 设 $a_1, a_2, \cdots, a_n$ 为正实数, $\alpha > \beta > 0$, 则
$\left(\frac{a_1^\beta + a_2^\beta + \cdots + a_n^\beta}{n}\right)^{\frac{1}{\beta}} \leq \left(\frac{a_1^\alpha + a_2^\alpha + \cdots + a_n^\alpha}{n}\right)^{\frac{1}{\alpha}}$,
$a_1^{\alpha_1} a_2^{\alpha_2} \cdots a_n^{\alpha_n} \leq \alpha_1 a_1 + \alpha_2 a_2 + \cdots + \alpha_n a_n$.
